name: Gods Word
overview: God's Word is portrayed as eternal and unchanging, standing firm even as the natural world fades away (Isaiah 40:8; Matthew 24:35). It serves as a guiding light for believers, illuminating their path in life (Psalms 119:105), and is essential for spiritual sustenance (Matthew 4:4). The Word is powerful and effective, accomplishing the purposes God intends without fail (Isaiah 55:11), and is ultimately identified with Christ Himself, who was with God in the beginning and is God (John 1:1).
